chunks: And ʿUbaydullāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the testimony of a midwife in childbirth.
He said: The testimony of one woman is accepted, and the testimony of women regarding the newborn and virginity is accepted.

key_terms.الْوَاحِدَةِ: one woman, whose testimony is accepted here

ai.seo_question: Is the testimony of a midwife or women accepted in cases of childbirth and virginity in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the admissibility of women’s testimony in matters specifically connected to childbirth and related female-specific conditions. It indicates that in such cases, the testimony of one woman or women may be accepted as proof.
